description: Angular component for managing a list of rate limits with form controls, validation, and change propagation.

classes.name: RateLimitsListComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for rate limits list management.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and subscribes to value changes.

methods.name: removeRateLimits
methods.description: Removes a rate limit entry at specified index.

methods.name: addRateLimits
methods.description: Adds a new rate limit form group.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for value change propagation.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes a rate limits string value into the form controls.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates the view and propagates changes based on rate limits array.

methods.name: uniqTimeRequired
methods.description: Validator function to ensure unique 'time' values within the list.
